name: Pie Models
author: mommymia
description: Eight flavours of mommymia's Pie Models, a family of Illustrious SDXL checkpoints each named after a pie, chosen from 19 after baking them all side by side: the flavours that look clearly different from each other. Anime: Apple Pie v2 (soft and glossy, the one to start with), Nutella (sharp lines), Jam (warm, amber eyes), Cherry (Western comic touch) and Raspberry (bold lines, dark and muted). Semi-real: Mango (glossy), Key Lime (soft lustre) and Impossible (near-photo faces). Prompt with Danbooru tags. Each card is its own 6.9 GB checkpoint.

presets.name: Pie Models: Apple Pie v2
presets.description:
Soft, glossy 2D and 2.5D anime with bright, pink-toned eyes and warm light. Of the Pie flavours this is the one to start with: most of the other anime flavours (Apple, Oreo, Honey, Fudge, Lemon, Quiche, Pecan) came out very close to it in our test. The author made v2 to fix hands while keeping Apple Pie's style.

Use Danbooru tags. The card adds masterpiece, newest, absurdres, incredibly absurdres, best quality, amazing quality, very aesthetic to the start of your prompt, so you don't need to type them.

This card uses the author's DPM++ 2M Karras at 30 steps and CFG 5. The author's sample pictures add a 1.5x hi-res pass, which this card does not run.

About 13 seconds a picture on a 12 GB card.

Model format: fp16, not quantized.
